mainEntity.name: How long does a full landscaping project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full property projects run longer than single-element work, and they often phase across a season. We map the schedule with you during design so you know what happens when, and we tell you the same day if weather shifts anything.

mainEntity.name: What does landscaping cost in Traverse City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every relationship and every project is unique. Scope, materials, site conditions, and how much of the property you're addressing at once all drive it. We provide a detailed written quote after walking your property, free and with no obligation, and the price holds for 30 days.

mainEntity.name: Can we phase the project over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and for larger properties it's often the smarter approach. We design the whole plan up front so each phase fits the finished vision, then build in stages that match your timeline and budget.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: We send a prep list before each phase begins. It generally covers clearing the work areas, marking irrigation and utilities, and confirming equipment access.

mainEntity.name: What are the phases of a landscaping project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consultation and site analysis, design development and approval, written quote with 30-day price lock, scheduling and prep, hardscape installation first, then planting and finish grading, then final detailing, cleanup, and a walkthrough of care and maintenance.
